Command palette Ctrl+K lists wired commands recents-first with category and chord, arrows navigate, Enter runs, Escape closes; capture mode consumes the key event so it never fires a command. tasks.title: WSL2 rendering fix and live QA driver
tasks.acceptance: App opens a window on WSL2/Xvfb without env tweaks; QA driver clicks, types, scrolls and screenshots; policy tested
tasks.evidence: Root cause: LIBGL_ALWAYS_INDIRECT=1 (~/.zshrc:296) made glutin's GLX FBConfig fail (GLXBadFBConfig) and, with no /dev/dri render node, Mesa 26 fell to zink (failed to choose pdev). app/src/gl_env.rs drops the indirect flag, forces software GL and X11 when there is no render node (WEBPROBE_GL=native opts out); 6 tests; matrix run on Xvfb: window mapped with 3000+ colours. qa/qa.sh up/shot/click/dclick/rclick/drag/type/key/scroll with proxy 6566 and collaborator 6567 (never 8080/8081). theme::install_fonts adds Hack as fallback; glyph guard test every_glyph_the_ui_prints_can_be_drawn. Commits 10bafe7, 6a969c1
